hypothesis: Two fixed unrelated example biographies may anchor generated food preferences: one dislikes cold foods; the other likes warm soup.
design: Three previously selected observed generator requests, one fresh replication with examples retained and one with examples removed per person, followed by the corresponding six frozen first-turn actor replays.
constants: All supplied characteristics, population eligibility, general generation rules, required output fields, actor instructions, chronological stimuli, schema, model gpt-6-luna, effort xhigh and captured output-token limits.
intervention: Remove unrelated worked biographies and replace only their output-format cross-reference with a description of permitted JSON structures.
acceptance: Preserve identity, eligibility and supplied traits; inspect generated preferences and actual public speech. Neither a higher rating nor a closer human mean is an acceptance criterion.
limitations: Small stochastic screen, not a population calibration. New biography elaborations are not unchanged-persona comparisons. Raw actor turns do not exercise quality correction or a complete notebook.
prior_harness_correction: The earlier generator-example-ablation screen omitted production JSON mode in both generator arms. Preserve its eleven returned responses and one malformed output as an out-of-contract diagnostic; this new folder contains the paired rerun with captured production generation options.
